snippet.title: Orbit Dash: Update 5.0.0 | Portals and Shape-Shifting Orbits (HYPNOTIC, ABRACADABRA)
snippet.description:
Orbit Dash: update 5.0.0 brings two mechanics the game has never had, in a new SPECIAL tab of levels.

HYPNOTIC, DEMON: the ball dives into a portal and comes out on another ring, right on the beat. Some portals are decoys. On three or more rings a soft glow shows where you will land. Our own 160 BPM track, and a SAFE mode on the level card with no flashes and the same score.
ABRACADABRA, INSANE: a voice says "now you see it", the brass hits, and the orbits bend into ellipses, twist and turn into triangles. The ball, the doors and your tap stay on the beat, only the path changes shape. Brass phonk at 128 BPM.
New trails: MESMER comes with HYPNOTIC, MIRAGE with ABRACADABRA, and its edges take the shape of the orbit.



▶ Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lewydo.orbitdash&referrer=utm_source%3Dyoutube%26utm_medium%3Dvideo%26utm_campaign%3Dupdate5_youtube
🍎 App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6824944395?pt=129589688&ct=update5_youtube&mt=8
All music is original, made by Lewydo.
